title: HtmlBlockquote
responsibility: Renders the native blockquote element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlBlockquote.attributes
inputs.description: Native blockquote attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlBlockquote.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native blockquote element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlBlockquote
outputs.description: The actual native blockquote element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
